facts.title: Creamy Basil Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium clove garlic, cut into several pieces
1 cup lightly packed fresh basil leaves (about 0.7 ounces)
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: Place the garlic in a food processor* and process until it’s finely chopped. Add the mayonnaise, basil, salt and pepper.
Process until smooth. Leftovers keep for up to 1 week in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

notes: Recipe inspired by the basil dip served with French fries at French Market in Kansas City.
Make it by hand: Finely chop the basil, press or mince the garlic, and whisk together the ingredients in a bowl.
facts.summary: This simple basil sauce packs so much fresh basil flavor! Use it in place of ranch dressing on your summertime sandwiches and meals. Recipe yields just over 1 cup.
